user.title: Grid connection
user.description: Pick the existing sensors of the grid connection Peak Basket calculates from. It talks to no device itself.

data_description.grid_power: Instantaneous grid power, import positive (e.g. P1 meter). Export may be negative.
data_description.pv_power: Instantaneous solar production. Adds the window's solar and grid energy per load and for the house. Export is read from a negative grid power.
data_description.window_average: The meter's running average for the current window (e.g. HomeWizard “average demand”, DSMR 1.4.0). It must average over the region's window (15 minutes in Flanders) and drop back to about 0 at every window start; a 5-minute average or an hourly one gives a wrong budget. Preferred over the import counter: exact, also right after a restart.
data_description.grid_import_energy: Import register (1.8.x) as a total-increasing energy counter. Used when no window average is set.
data_description.grid_export_energy: Export register (2.8.x) as a total-increasing energy counter. Gives the exact export per window; without it, export comes from a negative grid power.
data_description.month_peak: Highest window average this month; the target never goes below it.
data_description.meter_voltages: Voltage per phase at the meter, in order L1, L2, L3. Used for every load whose own voltage is missing; otherwise 230 V is assumed.

load.title: First load
load.description: The load Peak Basket tells how much power it may draw, such as an EV charger. Add more loads later with “Add load”.

data.name: Name
data.extra_a: Extra current in the last 5 minutes

data_description.voltages: Measured voltage per phase at the load, in order L1, L2, L3. They set its minimum and maximum power.
data_description.demand: On while the load wants power: a car plugged in, a thermostat calling for heat. Only then does an idle load keep its room from the loads after it. Without it, that claim lasts the reaction time.
data_description.priority: Lower goes first. A load gets what the loads before it leave unused; the loads after it yield to it.
data_description.reaction_s: Time between a lower limit and the load actually dropping (e.g. EVCC ≈ 20 s + 30 s cache).
data_description.min_charge_s: In pulse mode, only start when budget for at least this long is left.
data_description.extra_a: Catching up allowed above the base in the last 5 minutes of a window.

error.no_energy_source: Choose a window average or a grid import energy sensor.
error.same_as_grid: The load sensor must differ from the grid sensor.

data_description.peak_goal_w: Average power per window you allow. The target is the highest of this goal, the monthly peak and the region minimum.
data_description.margin_w: Kept free in every window to absorb measurement and timing errors.
data_description.max_age_s: Older source values count as unavailable and trigger the safe fallback.
